title.zh: 为特定目的重新划拨第1200号共和国法第一编A部分第4段马尼拉市第183页（ab）目第（19）项所拨款项的法案
title.en: An Act Reappropriating for Certain Purposes the Appropriation in Item (19), Page One Hundred Eighty-Three, Sub-Paragraph “Ab,” for the City of Manila, Paragraph 4, Title A, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred
title.orig: An Act Reappropriating for Certain Purposes the Appropriation in Item (19), Page One Hundred Eighty-Three, Sub-Paragraph “Ab,” for the City of Manila, Paragraph 4, Title A, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred

text.en:
The sum of ten thousand pesos appropriated in item (19), page one hundred eighty-three, subparagraph "ab," for the City of Manila, paragraph 4, title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby reappropriated for the following purposes:
(1) Sta. Clara Street Asphalting from Lamayan to Havana ₱6,000.00
(2) Trece de Agosto Street Asphalting from Paz to Estero de Paco 4,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
